You may have seen disinformation about @aliciagarza, @blackfutureslab and #BlackLivesMatter on your timeline. Those are attempts to discredit our movement before a crucial election.

This is the truth: https://t.co/s4zzK4urEn

Not cynical, but clear that this system wasn’t created to provide even the semblance of justice for Black women. My heart is with the loved ones of #BreonnaTaylor & the Louisville community. We’ll continue to rise up until impunity is no longer the status quo. #BlackLivesMatter

Much love to the courageous Nigerian #EndSARS activists. The movement for justice and dignity is global and I’m proud to see our kin rise up. There needs to be immediate end to the police brutality and extrajudicial killing of people in #Nigeria. #BlackLivesMatter #EndSarsNow https://t.co/UFR4cUS2Qf

Praying for our Nigerian family who’ve been brutalized for far too long. Shame on the Nigerian government. Know that the whole world is watching. And the people in the streets have our admiration and solidarity.
#EndSARS #BlackLivesMatter #EndSarsNow #PoliceBrutalityInNigeria

There’s no underestimating the power of the people. The Nigerian protests and global solidarity led to this announcement of the  dissolution of SARS. However this struggle is far from over. There must be accountability for every maimed and lost life. #EndSARS #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ihs48OGQ45
